brand: AgenticFab — Structural Aluminum & Steel Frame Co-Designer

networks.name: agentic_fab
networks.description: Multi-agent engineering assistant that designs 4040/4080 aluminum & steel workbenches, checks Euler-Bernoulli beam deflection against L/300 stiffness limits, optimizes 1D stock-bar cut lists (First-Fit Decreasing), syncs to a live SVG blueprint, and issues SHA-256 signed RFQs.
sample_queries: Design a 1600x800x750mm 4040-Heavy workbench for 250kg load & optimize 6000mm cut list
Check if 4040-Light passes 300kg distributed load over a 2000mm span
Issue a SHA-256 signed RFQ for 3 tables at 1400x700x750mm 4040-Heavy

peer_policy.note: Visitors explicitly approve each third-party peer origin before its agent-manifest.json is fetched. Visitor BYOK credentials are never sent to peer origins.

agent_mcp.reason: Static GitHub Pages bundle running client-side in the visitor's browser; a public MCP facade requires an application server.
